set.body:
Scope: VolumeAtlas/realizations, volume catalog assets/loaders, template grids/routes; neuroatlas4s optional volume/IO modules.

Deliverable: Compose atlas metadata and locus assignments with neuroim4s/image4s volume support. Move atlas-specific loading and template route policy; keep image format mechanics and transform kernels upstream.

Acceptance:
- Volume atlas -> query/region/reduction -> template route scenarios pass on JVM/JS where portable; JVM IO is isolated.
- Exact support/parcel domain alignment, display order, background/unknown labels, categorical values and reduction results are preserved.
- Native datatype/affine/scaling and asset hash/license/source fixtures survive; no surface/display dependency is required.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: A1: Move volume atlas realizations, loaders and mapping policy
